market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to slip 1-2% on oil-driven global risk-off and housing data. Qantas strike and Star distress add idiosyncratic risk. Iron ore weakness caps materials. RBA rate expectations create headwind for rate-sensitive sectors. Expect choppy, defensive trading.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook cautious. Housing correction may extend into 2027, pressuring banks and REITs. Oil volatility from Middle East persists. Rare earths and critical minerals offer structural growth. AI capex moderation could shift capital to energy and infrastructure. RBA likely to hold or hike once, keeping AUD firm.
